purpose.en: Train controlled alternating trunk rotation with the feet supported.

text.zh: 脚跟踩稳，缓慢转动胸廓，骨盆保持稳定
text.en: Keep your heels down and turn your rib cage slowly while your pelvis stays steady

text.zh: 坐姿轻微后倾，背部保持自然延长
text.en: Sit with a slight backward lean and keep the spine long.

text.zh: 向右转后先回中，再向左转，膝盖保持稳定
text.en: Turn right and return to the centre before turning left, keeping the knees steady.

text.zh: 双手随胸廓移动，不只甩动手臂
text.en: Let the hands travel with the rib cage rather than swinging only the arms.

commonErrors.zh: 脚离地、骨盆跟着摆动或腰背塌下
commonErrors.en: Lifting the feet, rocking the pelvis or collapsing the back.

commonErrors.zh: 快速甩臂代替可控躯干转动
commonErrors.en: Throwing the arms instead of controlling trunk rotation.

items.zh: 腰背：在舒适的小幅度内转动，不追求扭到极限。
items.en: Lower back: rotate through a comfortable controlled range without forcing an end position.

items.zh: 髋与足跟：足跟持续承托，保持坐姿平衡，不用腿部甩动补偿。
items.en: Hips and heels: keep the heels supported and stay balanced without swinging the legs.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制坐姿后倾或脊柱旋转时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if backward-leaning sitting or spinal rotation has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One turn to a side and return to centre counts as one rep; 8 seconds contains four alternating reps (right/left/right/left), equivalent to two right-plus-left cycles. Proposed reading of the existing 16-rep dose: 16 total turns, eight per side; editorial confirmation remains pending.
editorialNotes: root已裁决：默认16保持数字不变，按总16次单侧转动归中、每侧8次；8秒源为右/左/右/左4次，而非仅两次。编辑审核仍pending。
rhythm描述4秒左右完整pair-cycle，其中含2次计数；不要把每个4秒cycle只算1次或把旧repSeconds=3继续当真实节奏。
旧catalog明确替代h-band-pallof；它是抗旋转目标而非相同动态转体。独立降阶/负重进阶ID未有，减小后倾/转幅属于同ID调整。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b001.json真实秒区间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog，rhythm不附旧reps来覆盖默认剂量。
双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均已有具体草稿，pending表示未审而非缺数据；协同包含姿势稳定或次要拉伸角色，不作为肌电激活或额外高亮处方。
关系目标为本仓库真实ID候选，但未必已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系数组的缺口见逐动作说明。
医学通用筛查与证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md所列AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌。所有编辑与医学审核保持pending。
definition.movementSides: Source highlight remains both sides; direction alternates right/left/right/left.

switchPoint.semantics: One turn to a side and return to centre counts as one rep; 8 seconds contains four alternating reps (right/left/right/left), equivalent to two right-plus-left cycles. Proposed reading of the existing 16-rep dose: 16 total turns, eight per side; editorial confirmation remains pending. All encoded side changes: 2, 4, 6 seconds.
